## Deltas from ticket
- **`<img width>` instead of `![]()`.** The Portal's Markdown wrapper sets `max-width: initial`, so an image renders at its attribute size. Without a width, a 2800-px frame would render 2800 px wide. I measured the column at 785 px on a 1440-px viewport, where v11.19.0's screenshot already scrolls 258 px sideways. D1, D2 and G1 take 760; D4 takes 360, its CSS size, so its 720-px bitmap stays sharp on a 2× display.
